title: Inject the resolved API key at the auth boundary

epic.name: Async test suite through dependency injection

story.i_want_to: hand the pipeline the API key I inserted
story.so_that: the test need not commit a key AdminRepo can see

rationale: Loopctl.Auth.verify_api_key resolves the key on AdminRepo; a key inserted in the test's Repo sandbox transaction is invisible there, so these tests commit rows and run sync.

acceptance_criteria.description: Every converted module is `async: true`; the commit gate passes; production behaviour is unchanged (the injected input defaults to the value the code read before).

The boundary's real Auth.verify_api_key read runs against the test's own sandbox connection (Loopctl.AdminRepo routed onto Loopctl.Repo in test); no resolver is injected, since the resolved key is caller identity (CLAUDE.md, custody identity).
The resolver is set only by server-side code and test setup, never from request data (CLAUDE.md, custody identity).
One boundary test keeps exercising the real AdminRepo resolution.

test_cases.name: Auth-boundary tests run async
expected_results: 0 failures; no committed rows left behind
